title: Vanilla Intense
description: This is an optional modpack for the Vanilla Intense server
body:
# Vanilla Intense Modpack

The Vanilla Intense Modpack is an optional enhancement pack designed for the Vanilla Intense server. It improves the overall gameplay experience by adding performance optimizations, quality-of-life features, and visual enhancements while keeping the core vanilla survival feeling intact.

Although it is built with the Vanilla Intense server in mind, the modpack can also be used independently for a smoother and more immersive vanilla-style survival experience in singleplayer or other servers.

## Features
- Performance improvements for better FPS and stability
- Quality-of-life enhancements for survival gameplay
- Visual and UI improvements for clarity and immersion
- Lightweight design focused on vanilla gameplay feel
- Fully optional — not required to join the Vanilla Intense server

## Notes
This modpack does not change core Minecraft gameplay. It only enhances the experience while keeping everything close to vanilla survival.
